finding: @floating-ui/dom imported statically at top level. Adds ~5KB min+gz to any consumer importing hx-popover even if popover never opens.
suggestion: Dynamic import: const { computePosition, flip, shift, offset, arrow } = await import('@floating-ui/dom') inside _updatePosition()

finding: ~220 lines of color conversion utilities (hexToRgb, rgbToHsv, hsvToRgb, rgbToHsl, parseColor, formatColor) at module scope inflate bundle. Component is 5.64KB gz (within 8KB complex budget but largest after date-picker).
suggestion: Extract color utilities to separate color-utils.ts for better tree-shaking. Consumers importing type-only get no utility bloat.

finding: document.addEventListener('click', this._handleOutsideClick) registered in connectedCallback, active for entire component lifetime even when dropdown is closed. On forms with 10 comboboxes = 10 always-on document click listeners running composedPath().
suggestion: Add listener only when dropdown opens (_openDropdown), remove when it closes (_closeDropdown). Pattern already used by hx-date-picker and hx-color-picker.

finding: document.addEventListener('click', this._handleOutsideClick) registered in connectedCallback, active for entire component lifetime. Same issue as hx-combobox — always-on document listener even when closed.
suggestion: Register listener only when dropdown opens, remove on close.

finding: _updateGridFromPointer, _updateHueFromPointer, _updateOpacityFromPointer each call querySelector + getBoundingClientRect() on every pointermove event. Forced layout read per mouse move during drag operations.
suggestion: Use @query decorator to cache element refs. Cache getBoundingClientRect() at pointerdown time (element doesn't move during drag).

finding: _handleKeydown calls querySelectorAll('[part~="td"],[part~="th"]') on every keypress. For large tables this is O(n) cell enumeration on every arrow key.
suggestion: Cache cell list in @state field, invalidate when rows/columns change via updated() lifecycle.

finding: _renderDayGrid creates new Date object for every cell (~42) and calls toLocaleDateString() 42 times per render for aria-labels. _getDayName creates 7 Date objects per render for weekday headers.
suggestion: Memoize Intl.DateTimeFormat instances keyed on locale. Cache weekday header names — they only depend on locale which rarely changes.

finding: _getVisibleItems() recursively walks entire DOM tree on every keydown event. For deep trees with many expanded nodes, full DOM traversal per arrow key press.
suggestion: Cache visible items list, invalidate on expand/collapse events. Only recompute when tree structure changes.

finding: Each hx-tree-item walks up ancestor chain to compute nesting level and iterates siblings for posInSet/setSize in connectedCallback. 100-item tree = 100 parent chain walks + 100 sibling iterations = O(n^2).
suggestion: Have parent hx-tree-view set level/posInSet/setSize on items during slotchange handler. Converts O(n^2) to O(n).

finding: _hideBackgroundFromScreenReaders iterates document.body.children and calls child.contains(this) for each. In Drupal with many body-level elements, this touches dozens of nodes on every open.
suggestion: Cache sibling list if drawer opens/closes frequently. Replace contains() with direct parent chain walk.

finding: No virtualization for large row sets. Client-side pagination mitigates when pageSize is set, but consumers who forget pageSize with large datasets get poor rendering. devWarn at line 190 warns about >500 rows but no hard limit.
suggestion: Document pageSize requirement for >50 rows. Consider default pageSize of 50 when rows exceed threshold, or implement virtual scrolling.

finding: At 817 lines, hx-carousel includes touch handling, mouse dragging, autoplay logic, keyboard nav, and 6 inline SVG icons (~70 lines). One of the largest components.
suggestion: Extract touch/drag handlers into utility. For CDN consumers, candidate for lazy loading via IntersectionObserver. SVG icons could be externalized.

finding: Entire stylesheet pre-minified into single CSS line (~4.5KB raw). Calendar styling always loaded even when calendar popup never opened.
suggestion: Consider lazy stylesheet for calendar-specific styles applied only when _isOpen=true. Tradeoff: potential FOUC on first open.

finding: When open, 3 document-level listeners active: click + 2 keydown handlers. Two keydown listeners could be consolidated.
suggestion: Merge _handleDocumentKeydown and _handleFocusTrap into single keydown handler. Reduces document subscriptions from 3 to 2.

finding: Monolithic minified CSS ~3KB. Panel/grid/slider styles always loaded even when popover never opened.
suggestion: Monitor. Acceptable within 8KB complex budget. Consider lazy styles if component grows.

finding: Single-line minified CSS ~4KB. Includes multi-select chips, loading spinner, listbox styles loaded upfront.
suggestion: Monitor. Not actionable unless component exceeds budget.

finding: _getFocusableElements rebuilds focusableSelectors string from array on every invocation. Called on open and Tab keypress.
suggestion: Move focusableSelectors to module-level constant (pattern already used by hx-drawer with FOCUSABLE_SELECTORS at line 24-33).

finding: _getMonthName and _getDayName create new Date objects and call toLocaleDateString() on every render. Called 8+ times per render cycle.
suggestion: Cache weekday/month names in @state, update only when locale property changes.

finding: Document-level pointermove/pointerup listeners during drag. Pattern is correct (add on demand, remove on up). But getBoundingClientRect called per pointermove.
suggestion: Cache rect at pointerdown. Element position doesn't change during drag.

finding: sideEffects field correctly set to ["**/*.css"]. Per-component exports configured. Tree-shaking verified via esbuild metafile — individual imports pull only the target component. No barrel re-export side effects detected.
suggestion: No action needed. Tree-shaking is effective.

finding: exports map provides per-component entry points (./components/*). Consumers can import individual components without pulling the full library. Verified with esbuild bundle — no transitive dependency leakage.
suggestion: No action needed. Export configuration is correct.

finding: All 77 components within per-component budgets. Largest: hx-date-picker 6.14KB (8KB complex budget), hx-combobox 5.72KB (8KB), hx-color-picker 5.64KB (8KB). Smallest: hx-visually-hidden 0.63KB. No standard-budget component exceeds 5KB.
suggestion: Monitor hx-date-picker (76.8% of budget), hx-combobox (69.8%), hx-color-picker (68.8%) as they approach limits.

finding: 11 components use document-level listeners. All 11 properly implement removeEventListener in disconnectedCallback. Total: ~15 listener add/remove pairs. Pattern: bound handler stored as private field for reliable cleanup.
suggestion: No action needed. Listener hygiene is excellent across the library.

finding: 38 components implement connectedCallback. All are <15 lines, no blocking operations. Async/heavy operations properly deferred to firstUpdated() or updated(). SSR-safe typeof guards present.
suggestion: No action needed. Lifecycle discipline is strong.
